theme_central: Allah's knowledge, power and justice illustrated through striking narratives — at the heart of which Sulayman, who understands the speech of ants and converts the Queen of Sheba through wisdom rather than force.
sources_note: Narrative of Sulayman (15-44) precisely sourced (al-islam.org, enlightening commentary). Rest reconstructed from well-established landmarks.

branches.resume: The Qur'an, guidance and good news for the believers.

branches.title: Musa at the burning bush

branches.title: Sulayman, the ant, Bilqis

branches.title: Rhetorical questions on creation
